name: EVRoutes
description:
EVRoutes brings the trip-planning engine behind evroutes.com into Claude. Plan a full EV road trip with optimized charging stops, route polyline, and a time and battery breakdown; search
  public fast chargers near any place; calculate realistic range using a physics-based model that accounts for temperature, speed, weather, wind, elevation, and battery age; and browse a
  catalog of 200+ EVs through an interactive picker. Everything renders as native chat widgets with maps and range cards using Mapbox. No account or API key needed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add EVRoutes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add EVRoutes to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://evroutes-mcp-a025efa4.alpic.live/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the EVRoutes MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: EVRoutes provides these MCP tools: calculateRange, findChargersInRange, planRouteChargers, and searchVehicles.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to EVRoutes?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to EVRoutes in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
EVRoutes does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
EVRoutes is developed by EVRoutes. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
